source: Research pass 2026-11-25. Each value has a sourceUrl. Values are league-wide averages used to ESTIMATE free time around games, as requested.

assumptions.mlb_on_air_note: KNBR radio coverage runs ~15-30 min pregame and ~15-30 min postgame around the game itself; block = first pitch - 20 min to estimated final out + 10 min. Average game 2:42-2:44 in 2026 => 165 min game + 30 min coverage.
assumptions.nfl_on_air_note: Radio coverage on KNBR/WW1 includes pregame (~30 min) and postgame (~15 min). Average NFL game 3:02-3:12 => 192 min + 33 min coverage = 225 min on-air.
assumptions.nfl_halftime_note: Measured median halftime 14m15s in 2025 (within user's stated 15-30 band; Super Bowl halftime is longer, ~30 min).
assumptions.ncaaf_on_air_note: Average FBS game 3:26 (2025) = 206 min + ~30 min pregame/postgame radio coverage = ~240 min.
assumptions.ww1_pregame_note: Westwood One NFL coverage includes a pregame show before kick-off; conservative 30 min added before each WW1 broadcast.

averages.value: 3h02m median / 3h03m mean, kickoff to final snap (272 games); middle 80% 2h49m-3h18m
averages.note: Second source: 3h03m average 2025 regular season, halftime 13 min by rule: https://www.upintherafters.com/nfl/how-long-is-a-football-game

averages.value: 14m15s median measured halftime (13 min by rule; Super Bowl ~30 min)
